name: branding-cut-paper-pals-coffee-wordmark
title: Chunky cut-paper style PALS wordmark with irregular letters and a tight lockup
whatItIs: A white slide with tiny corner captions and a black wordmark 'PALS' whose letters look hand-cut from paper, uneven and tightly interlocked so the P, A, L and S share edges.
whatItMeans: Friendly and imperfect, like a neighbourhood coffee shop drawn by a friend.
techniques: Cut letters with slightly irregular edges as if from paper.
Interlock letters so they share contours.
Place tiny caps labels in the corners.

vocabulary.definition: Letters that share edges or overlap.
Small labels in the corners of a slide.
